# Day 4 - Agentic AI: agents vs bots vs copilots (NovaHome Official)

Date: Tue 24 Nov 2026 (workbook day: Mon 23 Nov)

## 1. Draft agent generated by Agentforce Assistant
Agentforce Studio > New Agent > "What do you want your agent to do?" (3 lines):
> Create a NovaHome FAQ Agent for NovaHome, a home furniture and appliance retailer in India.
> It answers customer questions about warranty cover, loyalty tiers and points, and delivery or shipment status.
> If it cannot answer or the customer is unhappy, it offers to hand over to a human support agent.

- Name NovaHome FAQ Agent (NovaHome_FAQ_Agent); running user: New User (dedicated agent user).
- Agent Optimizer proposed: Agent Router (updated), Warranty FAQ, Loyalty FAQ, Delivery FAQ (new), Escalation, Off Topic, Ambiguous Question.
- Proposed actions: GetOrdersByContact, GetOrderByOrderNumber (Asset Library) + GetWarrantyDetails, GetLoyaltyAccountDetails (custom, do not exist).
- Human review: told it to drop the two non-existent custom actions (in practice they caused 2 script errors). Accepted its clean-up offer -> "Clean compile - no errors, no warnings". Saved 9:45 AM. Draft (not committed).

## 2. Five-question preview log (Done when)
| # | Question | Subagent | Action | Answer (summary) | Correct for NovaHome? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | How long is the warranty on a sofa? | Warranty FAQ | none | "1-year warranty against manufacturing defects" (marked GROUNDED) | NO - policy: furniture 2 years |
| 2 | I am a Gold member. What extra benefits do I get? | Loyalty FAQ | none | 1.5 points per Rs 100, priority service, 100 points = Rs 50, 12-month expiry | Invented rules |
| 3 | Where is my order 00000102? | Delivery FAQ | **Get Order By Order Number** | "Shipped to 333 Wolf Point Plaza, Chicago... tomorrow before 1pm" | NO - template demo data |
| 4 | What is the weather in Pune today? | Off Topic | none | Redirects to orders/warranty/loyalty (SMALL_TALK) | Yes |
| 5 | This is useless, my sofa is broken... real person now | Escalation | escalate_to_human -> `__human__` | "Kindly hold as we connect you to the next available agent." | Yes |

Routing: 5/5 correct. Facts: 2/5 correct.

## 3. Lessons
- The Assistant invents business rules to fill gaps (sofa 1 year, point rates). Human review of generated instructions is mandatory.
- "GROUNDED" = consistent with the agent's own instructions or action output, not "true".
- Asset Library actions are templates: real Flow/Apex actions over Order/Shipment__c come on Days 9-10; real policy text in instructions on Days 8/11.

## Issues
| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Browser session expired | scripts/open_org.bat (`sf org open`) logs Chrome in without typing a password |
| Preview ignored the first question | Restart session (refresh icon), then click inside the chat box |
